arguments.summary: Program check-in between the executive director and a program coordinator. The youth workshop is behind after the facilitator cancelled, so it was decided to move it to January. The coordinator will finish a new workshop outline by Friday.

sections.heading: Updates
points: Workshop slipping: the youth workshop is behind because the facilitator cancelled.
The Tuesday drop-in was already cancelled last week.

sections.heading: Challenges and blockers
points: The facilitator cancellation is the main blocker; the ED would rather move the workshop than rush it.

sections.heading: Feedback
points: The coordinator asked how they are doing in the new role; the ED said really well.

sections.heading: Goals and development
points: The youth workshop moves to January, with a new outline due this Friday.
Carla in finance is to be asked to cut the cheque for the January facilitator.

arguments.text: Move the youth workshop to January.

arguments.evidence: As ED I'd rather we move it than rush it.

arguments.text: Ask Carla in finance to cut the cheque for the January facilitator
Okay, decided: we move the youth workshop to January.
I'll finish the new workshop outline by this Friday.
